== Notes ==
* Use [[Epidemic]] to spread the conditions from the target to adjacent targets.
* Synergy with [[Condition#Skills which inflict conditions on oneself|skills which inflict conditions on oneself]], especially those that draw conditions from allies to you, such as [[Foul Feast]], [[Draw Conditions]] and [[Verata's Sacrifice]].
* [[Profession|Primary]] [[PvP-only character|PvP-only]] Necromancers will be able to use this skill, even if it is not unlocked on your account.
* The AI will not prioritize [[fleshy]] targets when using this skill to transfer [[bleeding]] (for instance using it on [[minion]]s even if their [[minion master|master]] is in range).

== Trivia ==
* This is one of nine elite skills seen in [[pre-Searing Ascalon]] in {{reforgedmode}}, where it is used by [[Grawl Crone]]s. The other eight are [[Barrage]], [[Bull's Charge]], [[Earth Shaker]], [[Elemental Attunement]], [[Greater Conflagration]], [[Hundred Blades]], [["Victory Is Mine!"]], and [[Ward Against Harm]].
